title: Herbal Crumbly Filipino Oysters Bistek
description: A flavorful and aromatic Filipino dish featuring oysters, caramelized onions, and a blend of herbal spices, made FODMAP-friendly and crumbly in a bistek form.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, caramelize the onions over medium heat for 20 minutes.
Add the garlic-infused oil, lemongrass, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Arrange the oysters on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Spoon the caramelized onion mixture over the oysters.
Roll out the crumbly pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry dough over the oysters and onion mixture, crimping the edges to seal.
Bake the bistek in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the bistek from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
